title: Flag Battle 🔴 LIVE – A or B? Type in Chat!
description:
🚩 Flag Battle live 24/7. Type A or B in chat and climb the leaderboard.
⚔️ Country flag battle live: vote A or B, keep your streak, play with the chat. Every 30 seconds two flags fight – the flag with more votes wins and eats the other one. Vote for the winner to score.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Look at flag A (left) and flag B (right).
2. Type A or B in the chat (or the country name).
3. Everyone who voted for the winner scores: 1st = 10, 2nd = 7, 3rd = 5, everyone else 3 points.
4. Type ! and your country (e.g. !india) to get your flag next to your name.

🏆 TOP PLAYERS TODAY: the best voters of the day, live on screen.
🧩 More live games (Guess the Country by Its Shape, Guess the Word by Emoji, Guess the Capital): youtube.com/channel/UCG6xEYtopZcK66gz_biiIIA/streams

Be kind in the chat – names are shown on stream.

#flagbattle #flags #livestream
